SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mms_dispatch d
d.del_flag = '0' AND d.actual_start IS NOT NULL AND d.resource_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{resourceName}, '%') AND d.work_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{workOrderNo}, '%') AND DATE(d.actual_start) >= #{params.beginTime} AND DATE(d.actual_start) <= #{params.endTime}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT d.dispatch_id AS snapshot_id, d.dispatch_id, d.op_seq, d.process_name, COALESCE(rpt.stat_date, DATE(d.actual_start)) AS snapshot_date, d.resource_id, d.resource_name, d.work_order_id, d.work_order_no, 0 AS planned_hours, 0 AS run_hours, 0 AS downtime_hours, 0 AS availability, 0 AS performance, 0 AS quality_rate, 0 AS oee, d.plan_qty, d.good_qty, d.defect_qty, d.create_time FROM mms_dispatch d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.work_order_id, r.process_id, MAX(DATE(r.report_time)) AS stat_date FROM mms_work_report r WHERE r.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY r.work_order_id, r.process_id ) rpt ON rpt.work_order_id = d.work_order_id AND rpt.process_id = d.process_id WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.actual_start IS NOT NULL ) t WHERE t.dispatch_id = #{snapshotId}
